review_mandate: Aggressive pruning of redundant components, speculative abstractions, and custom reinvented system controls per Ponytail principles.

evaluations.candidate: Custom In-App Web Viewer / Browser Component
evaluations.issue: Reinvents platform web view with custom navigation bar and progress indicators.
evaluations.resolution: Use Android Custom Tabs (androidx.browser) and iOS SFSafariViewController directly. Zero custom webview components permitted.

evaluations.candidate: Custom Audio Player Widget for Temple Bells / Ambient Audio
evaluations.issue: Speculative entertainment feature not in PRD core travel jobs.
evaluations.resolution: Cut entirely. O-TRAVELZ V4 is an intelligent atlas and transit guide, not an ambient soundscape player.

evaluations.issue: Structurally identical FilterChip components with different data labels.
evaluations.resolution: Merged into a single native FilterChip with a category/district enum property, eliminating duplicate component maintenance.

evaluations.issue: Both represent expandable disclosures for unverified transit data.
evaluations.resolution: Unified into a single TruthDisclosureCard with variant property 'disclosureType'.

evaluations.candidate: Separate CompactPlaceRow variants for Search vs Map
evaluations.issue: Redundant card variants with minor trailing icon differences.
evaluations.resolution: Unified into single CompactPlaceRow with boolean property 'showTrailingDistance'.

evaluations.issue: Reinvents native Media3 / AVPlayer controls with custom timeline scrubber.
evaluations.resolution: Use native Jetpack Media3 PlayerView / SwiftUI VideoPlayer controls. Zero reinvented scrubbers.

evaluations.issue: Fake artificial intelligence typewriter latency simulation.
evaluations.resolution: Removed. Text renders deterministically as soon as the response is synthesized without simulated human typing delay.

evaluations.issue: Reinvents Android Intent.ACTION_SEND and iOS UIActivityViewController.
evaluations.resolution: Rely strictly on native system share sheets.

evaluations.issue: Violates anti-vibe-code and cultural restraint rules; adds unnecessary GPU overhead.
evaluations.resolution: Removed completely. A dignified confirmation checkmark and haptic impulse are used instead.

evaluations.candidate: Multi-tiered Nested Bottom Sheets on Map
evaluations.issue: Excessive gesture conflicts and nested scroll lag.
evaluations.resolution: Enforce single sheet with fixed detents (.fraction(0.35), .large); deep navigation pushes to full screen instead of stacking sheets.

reduction_summary.final_component_count_health: Clean, highly cohesive 44-component systems on both platforms with zero custom reinvented wheels.
